title: verifyTipReceiptInput
description: The request scripts/verify-tip-receipt.mjs reads via stdin: an endpoint id from the tip-endpoint catalog and a rail-specific claim.

claim.description: Rail-specific: card takes {stripeEventId}; hive takes {amount, asset, memo, observedAt, transactionId?, block?, nodes?, expiresAt?, fixtureResponses?}; base-usdc takes {amount, txHash, rpcUrls?}.
